actualTrackingIssueBody:
# F044: custom-base Razor section registration

Qualified **workload-dependent custom-base local result**, not a normal RazorPage or application-speedup claim.
Use concrete `Dictionary.TryAdd` only in `RazorPageBase.DefineSection`, preserving all guards,
case-insensitive duplicate behavior and original callback identity.

The predeclared SDK-compiled two-section registration primary uses **10.22% median paired less time**,
with **704 B/op unchanged**. All three source comparisons are closed: 576 retained samples.
The unchanged control moves 4.79% median, ranging -10.38% to 5.18%; uncertainty is retained.

**Adverse outcomes:** one-section registration median 3.17% more time, including a 40.06% individual
regression; full-view Eight median 6.74% more time. Full-view Two improves only 0.30%, not a material
full-view win. Long-name/scaled gains do not replace the primary or establish production frequency.

Both source variants pass all 59 owning test rows, including each new direct-base duplicate row.
Actual current-default and original/candidate SDK producers pass ten contracts and twelve
registration/rendering boundaries. A fresh exact-project rebuild reproduces both without timing.
The direct-base fixtures supply their required abstract context hooks and reject use as layouts;
real RazorPage layouts consume every section through real scoped pooled buffering.

| Complete benchmark and scope guide | [Immutable evidence](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/6bfcabd8cd2cea25d29bf60337f9c595a5eb44b9/F044/README.md) |
| All results, including regressions and variability | [Comparison tables](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/6bfcabd8cd2cea25d29bf60337f9c595a5eb44b9/F044/comparison-results.md) |
| Exact commands, actual outcomes and preparation failure | [Validation catalog](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/6bfcabd8cd2cea25d29bf60337f9c595a5eb44b9/F044/validation-commands.md) |
| XML-parsed preservation cases | [Actual 59+59 rows](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/6bfcabd8cd2cea25d29bf60337f9c595a5eb44b9/F044/actual-paired-test-row-validation.json) |
| Independent reconstruction | [Fresh restore/build and both consumers](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/6bfcabd8cd2cea25d29bf60337f9c595a5eb44b9/F044/reproduction-paired-001/verified-reproduction.json) |

The candidate was measured before its later publication commit; physical source/PDB snapshots
identify the actual edit. No new public API, allocation-saving, broad throughput or merge-ready
claim. Fork-only research tracking; the draft and additive final receipt will be linked after creation.

Fork research draft: [jaslawinMs/aspnetcore#159](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/pull/159). The immutable evidence snapshot predates its additive publication receipt; use the [current case guide](https://github.com/jaslawinMs/aspnetcore/blob/autoperf-results/F044/README.md) for that late receipt. All609sealed source/results files stay pinned and unchanged. Qualified custom-base scope and every adverse result remain; not merge-ready.

Use one dictionary probe for custom-base Razor section registration

## Description

**Fork-only research draft; qualified custom-base registration result, not merge-ready.**
The declared two-section primary uses **10.22% median paired less time, 704 B/op unchanged**.
This changes `RazorPageBase.DefineSection`, **not** the override used by ordinary `RazorPage<T>`.
No normal RazorPage, application-throughput, allocation-saving or production-frequency claim.

Use the class's concrete `Dictionary<string, RenderAsyncDelegate>.TryAdd` to retain one insertion
probe on populated stores. Preserve null guard order, case-insensitive duplicate detection,
attempted-name error text and the original delegate. The private readonly store is initialized
in this non-partial class and returned through a get-only nonvirtual property; the cast follows
that internal invariant. The interface `TryAdd` extension would retain the extra lookup.
There is no public API or field-type change.

### Results and limitations

| Pair | Order | Original ns/op | Candidate ns/op | Less time | Unchanged registration control less time | B/op |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Original, Candidate | 138.16 | 124.04 | 10.22% | 4.79% | 704 / 704 |
| 2 | Candidate, Original | 124.80 | 121.80 | 2.40% | -10.38% | 704 / 704 |
| 3 | Original, Candidate | 168.64 | 144.79 | 14.14% | 5.18% | 704 / 704 |

Primary `RegisterFreshPage/Two` is faster in all three pairs and exceeds its paired unchanged
control each time. The predeclared timing and control gates pass, but **controls and primary
variance are material** on this shared machine: control median 4.79%, range -10.38% to 5.18%;
primary CV reaches 11.56%. This is not a precise or uniform performance guarantee.

**Regressions are part of the proposal:** one-section registration is 3.17% slower at the median,
including an individual 40.06% regression. Full-view Eight is 6.74% slower at the median, and
full-view One is 0.35% slower. Full-view Two is only 0.30% faster: **no material full-view win**.
Registration Eight/SixtyFour/EightLong medians are 12.42/23.88/39.04% less time, with unchanged
allocations; the deliberately long-name workload is not asserted representative.
All 12 cases, 72 report rows, 576 retained observations and adverse byte/timing outcomes are
published. Three comparisons are permanently consumed; no fourth run or retuned primary.

### Why the producer and new tests matter

The six actual SDK-compiled `.cshtml` fixtures explicitly inherit `RazorPageBase`, so their generated
`ExecuteAsync` methods reach the changed inherited method. Each type's direct base and resolved
`DefineSection.DeclaringType` are checked. Registration is not copied into a synthetic surrogate.
The ordinary `RazorPage` override and its separate F043 no-gain outcome remain unchanged.

Direct-base content fixtures provide the three required abstract hooks: the context hooks are
empty like `RazorPage`, while `EnsureRenderedBodyOrSections` throws if incorrectly used as a layout.
A separate real `RazorPage` layout consumes the sections through actual `RazorView`,
`MemoryPoolViewBufferScope`, transfer and disposal. Custom layouts are not evaluated.

Existing duplicate-registration coverage uses the different `RazorPage` override.
`DefineSection_BaseImplementationRejectsCaseInsensitiveDuplicateWithoutReplacingWriter`
therefore adds the `"scripts"` and `"SCRIPTS"` rows using `Mock<RazorPageBase> { CallBase = true }`.
Each row independently passes on original and candidate and asserts attempted-name exception,
original key/delegate identity, deferred execution and eventual original output.
The complete owning class passes **59 original + 59 candidate**, zero failed/skipped.
These are preservation tests, not a bug-fix red/green claim.

Current default `31c15331c03714b7a602e1817e65881474c29e2e` was actually built and characterized.
Its Razor-area tree matches the independent `37e809ead5824bc753a1c3d56f11615bdb1296c5` baseline.
Default/original/candidate pass ten contract cases and twelve actual producer/rendering boundaries.
A separate restored/rebuilt 13-file project passes both variants without further timing.

Only the measured owner DLL/PDB differ between the 264-file images; the other 262 files, including
the common harness, are identical. Loaded PE/PDB identity and executable source checksums are
verified. The candidate was built before publication; physical source snapshots/PDB checksums,
not the later commit URL or baseline SourceLink, identify the executed edit.

Three warmups/eight retained iterations/requested 100 ms; settings-preserving in-process executor.
No priority, affinity or power changes. The managed build excludes native IIS, Node and static

The first harness attempt failed 21 CS0534 errors for missing abstract fixture members; its exact
